paragraphs.en: The new research facility promised to bring technical expertise to local agriculture. Its first proposal involved artificial intelligence, satellite images, and a database of soil conditions. Researchers could forecast drought, calculate water demand, and display a detailed chart on a mobile telephone. Yet a farmer asked whether any of this would work where electricity was unreliable and an email took minutes to send. The question changed the project. Innovation would be judged not by the sophistication of a demonstration, but by whether its benefits survived contact with ordinary working conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 新研究设施承诺把技术专长带到本地农业。最初方案涉及人工智能、卫星影像和土壤条件数据库。研究者可以预测干旱、计算水需求，并在手机上显示详细图表。然而，农民问，这些东西在供电不可靠、发邮件要几分钟的地方能否使用。问题改变了项目。创新的评价标准将不是展示有多先进，而是接触日常工作条件后，其益处能否继续存在。

paragraphs.en: An interdisciplinary team combined biology with engineering. A specialist explained how a gene influenced resistance to disease, while another warned that a clone selected for one useful trait might remain vulnerable to other threats. Organic cultivation required understanding a whole system, not treating every living element as an isolated component. Farmers contributed feedback about pests and rainfall that no remote camera had captured. Researchers also considered the cognitive effort required to interpret an unfamiliar instrument. A useful technique should reduce unnecessary confusion rather than demand that busy users become experts in its internal workings.
paragraphs.zh: 跨学科团队把生物学与工程结合。专家解释某个基因如何影响抗病能力，另一人提醒，为某一有用性状选出的克隆植株，仍可能易受其他威胁。有机种植需要理解整个系统，不能把每个生命要素当作孤立部件。农民提供了远程摄像头未捕捉到的虫害和降雨反馈。研究者也考虑理解陌生仪器所需的认知努力。有用技术应减少不必要的困惑，而不是要求忙碌用户成为其内部机制的专家。

paragraphs.en: The prototype used a small motor, a rechargeable battery, and a silicon chip protected beneath a waterproof layer. Its steel frame could be repaired by a local metal worker, and damaged plastic parts could be replaced without discarding the whole unit. A simple meter measured the volume of liquid passing through a pipe. The software displayed both a gallon and its metric equivalent, avoiding mistakes when older equipment used different measures. Instructions came in a plain format with a short video. Reliability depended as much on understandable maintenance as on the quality of electronic design.
paragraphs.zh: 原型使用小马达、充电电池和被防水层保护的硅芯片。钢框架可由本地金属工修复，塑料部件损坏时可单独更换，不必丢弃整台装置。简单仪表测量通过管道的液体体积。软件同时显示加仑及其公制换算值，避免旧设备使用不同单位时出错。说明采用朴素格式，附有短视频。可靠性既依赖电子设计质量，也同样依赖易懂的维护方法。

paragraphs.en: Energy choices required equal care. An old engine consumed fuel while generating heat, so researchers compared it with efficient pumps and better shared infrastructure. They calculated carbon dioxide released per ton of produce rather than reporting only emissions from the farm itself. Packaging had to be included: replacing one compound in a container did not help if the new material could not be collected to recycle. Even nuclear energy entered the debate because the regional electricity supply affected the total footprint. The team resisted reducing these interconnected choices to a single flattering number.
paragraphs.zh: 能源选择需要同样谨慎。旧发动机消耗燃料并产生热量，研究者将它与高效水泵和更好的共享基础设施比较。他们计算每吨农产品产生的二氧化碳，而不只报告农场内部排放。包装也要考虑：如果新材料无法收集回收，更换容器中的某种化合物并不一定有帮助。连核能也进入讨论，因为区域电力来源影响整体环境足迹。团队拒绝把这些相互关联的选择简化成一个漂亮数字。

paragraphs.en: The final device looked less impressive than the first proposal, but its adoption was easier. Training acknowledged the practical craft of people who had managed difficult land for decades. Farmers could challenge a recommendation, record a local exception, and obtain assistance without a specialist visiting every week. The research team learned that participation was not an optional addition after design. It was part of discovering what the problem actually was. Technology became useful when technical ambition met the experience of its users, and when responsibility for failure remained with the designers rather than being transferred silently to those users.
paragraphs.zh: 最终装置看起来不如最初方案耀眼，却更容易推广。培训承认农民几十年管理困难土地所积累的实践技艺。农民可以质疑建议、记录本地例外，并获得帮助，而不用专家每周来访。研究团队认识到，参与不是设计完成后的可选附加项，而是发现问题究竟是什么的一部分。当技术抱负与使用者经验相遇，失败责任仍由设计者承担，而不悄悄转嫁给用户时，技术才真正有用。
